run_place_with_target: run the place skill on a Spot robot by specifying a target x,y,z coordinate in meters
run_place_with_waypoints: run the place skill on a Spot robot using comma-separated waypoint names from a YAML config
run_place_local_frame: run the place skill with target coordinates relative to the robot's local base frame
run_place_with_policies: run the place skill using learned RL policies instead of the Boston Dynamics API
parse_arguments_place: parse command-line arguments for place target coordinates, waypoints, local frame flag, and policy usage
